verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager and build system with an ecosystem, including binary caches served over HTTP, so a published machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows no such spec: the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and the docs describe only the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
